sampling_protocol: Deduplicate exact text preserving first occurrence; select three disjoint demonstration examples first (2 spam, 1 ham), then select 500 spam and 500 ham without replacement using fixed random seeds; shuffle test set.
notes: Balanced test distribution is artificial, not natural prevalence.
3-shot demonstrations are fixed and excluded from the test set.
Do not use labels as LLM inputs; keep for evaluation only.
Source_row is one-based row number within source file.
No text preprocessing beyond exact-text deduplication.
